value_stream.name: Construction Project Material Staging & Phased Delivery

fields.Participants: Logistics Coord, DC Ops, Trade Sales Rep, Contractor

workflows.name: Phase Delivery Trigger & Material Staging at DC

Automation Opportunity: - Delivery scheduling auto-optimized from the route/dock/traffic data; real-time tracking auto-pushed to customer and store; POD auto-captured digitally
Controls: - CTL-461 (ensure controlled execution — Phased Delivery Execution & Site Coordination (PA-77.2).)
- operational: Logistics Coordinator sign-off on the workflow output
Pain Points / Risks: - **Delivery-failure risk**: a delivery misses its window (traffic, access, scheduling), disrupting the customer/project; mitigated by the real-time tracking and the rescheduling protocol

- **Data-quality risk**: incomplete or inaccurate master data (pricing, inventory, customer) corrupts the workflow output; mitigated by the master-data governance (VS-29 / W291) and the periodic audit
System Touchpoints: - Order management (links to VS-08 / W536 unified order management, VS-60 / W2286 routing)
- Logistics/DC (links to VS-04 / W3 receiving, VS-04 / W52 fleet, VS-77 / material staging)
- Analytics/BI (links to VS-27 / W113)
Time Estimate: - Absorbed into the Logistics Coordinator role; not incremental headcount unless volume scales significantly.

steps.activity: Contractor notifies phase readiness (3–5 days advance); Rep triggers phase delivery order; Logistics verifies availability in project staging area at DC
steps.r: Contractor / Trade Sales Rep / Logistics Coordinator

steps.activity: DC Ops picks and stages: verifies quantities against phase list, stages at loading dock, creates manifest; Quality inspects outbound materials
Logistics Coordinator schedules delivery: assigns truck, coordinates time with contractor, arranges special equipment; sends confirmation with ETA

steps.activity: Driver arrives: contacts site rep, directs to unloading area; rep verifies manifest against phase list item by item; checks for transit damage
Site rep accepts: signs receipt noting exceptions; photographs materials; Driver photographs signed receipt and uploads via app
Trade Sales Rep reviews: processes accepted delivery, triggers billing milestone, addresses exceptions (replacement, shortage investigation, reservation adjustment)

steps.activity: Trade Sales Rep advises on storage: cement off-ground under cover, tiles flat on pallets, lumber with spacers for air circulation, paint in cool dry area
Rep conducts periodic site storage assessment: verifies proper storage, identifies issues, advises corrective action; documents for project file
If material damaged from improper storage: coordinates replacement at contractor's expense (not BuildRight liability post-delivery); documents for insurance

fields.Participants: Trade Sales Rep, Supply Planning, Contractor

Automation Opportunity: - Material-demand auto-forecast from the project schedule; delivery-phasing auto-sequenced; site-reconciliation auto-tracked from the delivery-vs-installed delta

System Touchpoints: - Inventory/ATP (links to VS-05 / W105 multi-channel allocation, VS-29 / W252 item master)

steps.activity: Contractor requests reallocation: construction ahead/behind schedule; wants to move materials between phases; Rep documents request
Supply Planning evaluates impact: checks if reallocating causes future stockout, identifies if additional procurement needed, adjusts reservation
Trade Sales Rep confirms reallocation: adjusted quantities, cost implications, updated schedule; updates ERP; monitors for cascading impacts

fields.Participants: Trade Sales Rep, Receiving Clerk, Finance, Contractor

Automation Opportunity: - Material-takeoff auto-computed from the project dimensions; quotation auto-generated from the takeoff × pricing; project-status auto-tracked from milestone completion
Controls: - CTL-461 (ensure controlled execution — Phased Delivery Execution & Site Coordination (PA-77.2).)
- operational: Trade Sales Representative sign-off on the workflow output
Pain Points / Risks: - **Condition-dispute risk**: the contractor disputes the resaleability assessment or restocking fee at pickup, delaying the credit and stranding the surplus; mitigated by the documented condition inspection with photos at pickup and the pre-agreed restocking terms

- **Data-quality risk**: incomplete or inaccurate master data (pricing, inventory, customer) corrupts the workflow output; mitigated by the master-data governance (VS-29 / W291) and the periodic audit
System Touchpoints: - Project/design (links to VS-11 / W58 corporate account, VS-66 / W211 design)
- Logistics/DC (links to VS-04 / W3 receiving, VS-04 / W52 fleet, VS-77 / material staging)
- Analytics/BI (links to VS-27 / W113)
Time Estimate: - Absorbed into the Trade Sales Representative role; not incremental headcount unless volume scales significantly.

steps.activity: Contractor identifies surplus: unused tiles, excess cement, leftover lumber, extra fixtures; contacts Rep; verifies eligibility (unused condition, within return window)
Logistics arranges pickup; Receiving Clerk processes return: inspects condition, accepts if resaleable, routes to inventory
Finance processes credit: at original price minus restocking fee (5–10%); adjusts billing; Trade Sales Rep conducts project close-out review

steps.activity: Procurement Manager coordinates: identifies all vendors, maps lead times (local: 7–21 days, import: 45–90 days), sequences POs for on-time phase delivery
Procurement monitors vendor performance against project timeline: tracks shipments, escalates late deliveries, arranges substitute sourcing
Supply Planning coordinates DC staging: ensures multi-vendor materials consolidated before delivery date; manages receiving schedule and quality inspection

workflows.name: Project Delivery SLA Compliance & Penalty Management

Automation Opportunity: - Delivery scheduling auto-optimized from the route/dock/traffic data; real-time tracking auto-pushed to customer and store; POD auto-captured digitally
Controls: - CTL-182 (ensure jobsite delivery accuracy & site reconciliation.)
- CTL-461 (compliance-monitoring — links to VS-22); Operational: Trade Sales Manager sign-off on the workflow output
Pain Points / Risks: - **Delivery-failure risk**: a delivery misses its window (traffic, access, scheduling), disrupting the customer/project; mitigated by the real-time tracking and the rescheduling protocol
- **Non-compliance risk**: a regulatory requirement is missed (DTI permit, data privacy, AML), creating a fine or complaint; mitigated by the compliance-checklist and the regulatory-monitoring
System Touchpoints: - Order management (links to VS-08 / W536 unified order management, VS-60 / W2286 routing)
- Compliance/risk (links to VS-22 / regulatory, VS-86 / AML, VS-91 / privacy)
- Project/design (links to VS-11 / W58 corporate account, VS-66 / W211 design)
Time Estimate: - Absorbed into the Trade Sales Manager role; not incremental headcount unless volume scales significantly.

steps.activity: Logistics Manager reports delay: root cause (DC error, vendor late, truck breakdown, weather, access), revised ETA; Rep communicates to contractor
Trade Sales Rep manages SLA penalty: if contract includes penalty (1%/day late), Finance calculates; Rep negotiates resolution (waiver, expedited replacement)
Logistics Manager conducts root cause analysis: implements prevention (earlier staging, backup trucks, weather planning); tracks on-time rate (target: ≥95%)

fields.Participants: Trade Sales Mgr, Finance, Supply Planning, Contractor

Automation Opportunity: - Material-takeoff auto-computed from the project dimensions; quotation auto-generated from the takeoff × pricing; project-status auto-tracked from milestone completion
Controls: - CTL-461 (ensure controlled execution — Phased Delivery Execution & Site Coordination (PA-77.2).)
- operational: Trade Sales Manager sign-off on the workflow output
Pain Points / Risks: - **Condition-dispute risk**: the contractor disputes the resaleability assessment or restocking fee at pickup, delaying the credit and stranding the surplus; mitigated by the documented condition inspection with photos at pickup and the pre-agreed restocking terms

- **Site-readiness risk**: delivery arrives before the site can receive (no crane slot, access blocked, phase incomplete), forcing re-delivery and demurrage; mitigated by the site-readiness confirmation gate before dispatch
System Touchpoints: - Pricing/financials (links to VS-17 / W9 financial close, VS-29 / W289 pricing master)
- Project/design (links to VS-11 / W58 corporate account, VS-66 / W211 design)
- Logistics/DC (links to VS-04 / W3 receiving, VS-04 / W52 fleet, VS-77 / material staging)

steps.activity: Trade Sales Manager initiates reconciliation: compares ordered vs. delivered vs. returned, reconciles all phases, verifies no outstanding requests
Finance completes billing: all payments received, retention released, credits settled, project account closed; produces final P&L
Supply Planning releases unused reservations: returns inventory to general stock, closes staging areas, cancels remaining POs; Trade Sales Manager conducts lessons-learned review
